address: Hornweg 5, Sankt Johann in Tirol, 6380, Austria
bio: This restaurant presents a dual concept: Diners choose between creative à la carte options and an intriguing tasting menu. The latter is given the name of a fairy tale or story, such as Lisa and Lottie, the different chapters of which are then represented in the courses. The dishes are prepared in a contemporary style and made with carefully selected ingredients. The restaurant is housed in the hotel of the same name, not far from the cableway station....
